test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
What would be the symbol on the opposite side of '@' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08af37b9cfa2875a71e1bfe195fe5f42f3ddea2bc221073a0e427b52d018512b.png]
solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below methods: -

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners.

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

Below are the opposite surfaces: -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28b3e31c2ff370123c320c8f12a875c7013760b5ae1c9c914333d23686736d8a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cc17b97fbac74dc53cfdf9ce12aa0ecf0d6474795a2c09473156378d9fa93f8.png] 

Here, we can see that the symbol on the opposite side of '@' is '&'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"&"**.
